question: Which native hook relay observability shape should remain open for the Codex relay fan-out investigation?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102241 both instrument the same relay investigation, and choosing per-handler timing logs versus aggregate relay metrics is an operations/product judgment rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Prefer Aggregate Metrics After Proof
options.body: After redacted real-run proof is added, use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102241 as the main relay observability lane and ask for any plugin-handler timing need to be split narrowly.

options.title: Keep This Timing PR
options.body: Proceed with this PR if maintainers specifically want per-handler plugin timing logs in addition to relay invocation timing, after the contributor adds real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause Both Instrumentation PRs
options.body: Keep both observability PRs paused until the broader relay fan-out mitigation direction for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91009 is settled.

recommendation.title: Prefer Aggregate Metrics After Proof
recommendation.body: After redacted real-run proof is added, use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102241 as the main relay observability lane and ask for any plugin-handler timing need to be split narrowly.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent adjacent relay work make this the strongest available routing candidate for choosing the observability shape.
